code: extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)
note: The fuzzer input is an attacker-controlled pcap byte stream.
The input bytes are copied verbatim into the temporary pcap file consumed by the reader.
The first pcap record is parsed as Ethernet followed by IPv4 with protocol number 47.
The IPv4 protocol byte selected by the PoC routes parsing into the GRE branch.
The second GRE byte has low bits equal to 1, so the packet is classified as GREv1.

code: m_NextLayer = new GREv1Layer(payload, payloadLen, this, m_Packet);
note: A GREv1 layer is constructed even though payloadLen is only 4 bytes, shorter than sizeof(gre1_header).
After layer iteration, the harness asks every parsed layer to recalculate mutable fields.
The GREv1 layer compute function is invoked from last layer to first layer.
The 16-bit payloadLength write targets bytes 4..5 of a heap region that contains only the 4-byte GRE basic header.
